Caput XXXV. De Membranis Nominatis & Innominatis.
Dhuc de involventibus universalibus: particulare involvens est, quod membra particularia & certa in corpore universo involvit:
MEMBRANA est particularium membrorum cute tenuius, densius, & siccius involucrum & tegumentum.
Membrana alia nomine insignita est, alia nomine caret.
Membrana nomine insignita est, quæ præstantia corporis membra ambit & vestit.
Est autem ea ossium vel aliorum membrorum.
Ossium membrana est propria unius, vel communis multis.

page.notes: Right-margin notes are printed in small italic: "Membrana simplex." and "Membranarum distinctio." Show-through text from the reverse page is present throughout the background and was not transcribed. The line "Dhuc de" is printed with a decorated initial A, read as "A" joined to "Dhuc"; the first word is therefore printed "Adhuc" in the initial and is shown here as printed. The Latin "Membrana alia" and "vel aliorum" lines are read with reasonable confidence; "Est autem ea ossium" is read as printed.
